coverage.title: Coverage period
coverage.text: Treatment must fall entirely between 2026-01-01 and 2026-12-31 inclusive and before any effective lapse date.

benefit.title: Outpatient benefit
benefit.text: Outpatient treatment is covered subject to eligibility, documentation, medical necessity and exclusions.

documents.title: Required evidence
documents.text: A complete claim form, invoice and medical report of the correct document type are required. Request missing or incomplete evidence before deciding the claim.

medical.title: Medical necessity
medical.text: Treatment must be appropriate for the diagnosis under the demo medical rules. Unknown appropriateness requires additional medical evidence; inappropriate treatment is excluded.

exclusion.title: Cosmetic exclusion
exclusion.text: Procedure cosmetic_surgery is excluded from cover. This demo policy has no accident exception.

limit.title: Annual insurer payout limit
limit.text: Annual outpatient insurer payout limit is VND 5000000. Previously used insurer payout in 2026 is VND 1000000. Cap payout at the remaining limit; partially approve when remaining limit is positive; reject if exhausted. Assessment does not reserve or pay funds.

copay.title: Member copay
copay.text: Member copay is 20% of eligible submitted amount, rounded half up to whole VND, before capping insurer payout. Member also bears excess above remaining limit. No deductible applies.

waiting.title: Waiting period
waiting.text: Treatment may start 30 calendar days after 2026-01-01, including day 30. Earlier treatment is excluded.

medical_rules.explanation: Synthetic interview rule: consultation and throat test match pharyngitis.
Synthetic rule; medical appropriateness does not establish coverage.
